calibration_rule: Calibrate only on cases excluded from the benchmark and never inspect comparative condition performance. Freeze one common budget large enough for every condition to complete its required workflow without systematic truncation.
confirmatory_exclusion_rule: Reaching a frozen resource ceiling is an observed benchmark outcome and is not an exclusion. Only an exogenous infrastructure or configuration failure that prevents the frozen condition from being executed as specified may make the entire four-condition case nonratable, and that classification must be condition-blind. No case replacement is permitted after S1. More than 3 of 60 such cases makes the campaign INDETERMINATE; with 1-3, report complete-case results plus the frozen best/worst-case sensitivity analysis.
